course.title: L17 Clinic Body Picture
course.description: 看诊所身体图，说明腿、嘴、鼻子、皮肤、胃、肌肉、神经和针。 场景：学员在诊所看身体图和桌上的针，继续用位置、拥有和不舒服句描述身体部位。 目标词：leg, lip, mouth, muscle, neck, needle, nerve, nose, skin, stomach。核心句型：This is a/an ... / ... is under ... / This is my ... / ... is near ... / This is a ... / ... is in ... / ... is on ... / Do you see ...?。
